title: Sekho
text: 1. Sāvatthi || || 2. Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pa || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sekho sekho ti bhante vuccati || || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante sekho hotī ti || || 4. Idha [bhikkhave] bhikkhu sekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā sammannāgato hoti || la || sekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti || || Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu sekho hotī ti || ||
